trigger: RBAC enforced; a cookie session with the legacy admin role but without Infrastructure:Write (or without GuaranteedState:Read) POSTs /api/settings/dex-scoring/{save,preview,reset}
summary: The three Scoring POSTs authorise differently from their REST twin: the first gate is the quiet read_perm probe (a refused cookie session writes no denied audit row) and the write gate is the legacy admin role (admin_gate_verdict, never RBAC) instead of Infrastructure:Write, so a principal refused on PUT/DELETE /api/v1/dex/score-policy can write through the tab via the same apply_dex_score_policy. security-guardian F1, architect A1 and consistency-auditor 1 raised it independently; compliance-officer C1 echoed after being shown F1. Other reviewers' native bands differed (consistency-auditor MEDIUM, compliance-officer LOW as a design disclosure); the derived band is HIGH.
classification_rationale: the tab is presented as a view over the REST pair (ADR-1005) yet authorises differently and leaves no denied row; the stated contract and the code disagree

trigger: an authorised admin posts up to 8193 distinct overrides[N].* pairs (indices to 9999, ~172 KB body) with one bad field; the htmx refusal re-renders every posted row
summary: dex_form_values drops only all-blank rows; the 255 index and 200 row caps live in dex_form_to_document, so overrides_panel renders every distinct posted row on a refusal: ~50-65 MB of HTML, ~150-250 MB transient, ~200x amplification (performance measured). security-guardian F2, sre S1, unhappy-path 5 and cpp-safety 2 independent.
classification_rationale: the form advertises a 200-row cap that the refusal render path does not apply

trigger: reviewer compares the Scoring tier-change preview against ADR-1005's no-UI-only-capability rule
summary: The tier-change preview is a UI-only capability (REST dry_run answers only the validated document and revision; dex_tier_preview over dex_apps_fn_ has no REST or MCP twin) and the dex.json preview row names PUT as its twin. ADR-1005 forbids a UI-only capability without a recorded exception, and the 2026-11-02 entry says 'No ledger row is added', now stale. architect A2; enterprise-readiness F2 related, consistency-auditor 6 an INFO echo.
classification_rationale: a required ADR exception-ledger entry for a UI-only capability is missing; nothing contradicts it

trigger: an operator reads docs/user-manual/metrics.md after this change adds the dex_score_policy_form body-cap class

trigger: a dashboard-only operator saves or resets the score policy during a rolling upgrade or rollback

classification_rationale: a required operator caution for a shipped behaviour change is missing

trigger: an auditor reads docs/user-manual/audit-log.md for the csrf.denied row a cross-site Scoring POST produces
summary: audit-log.md claims the route's own csrf.denied row; for a cookie session the central pre-routing same-site gate answers first ('csrf.denied (central gate)') and the route copy fires only if bypassed. trigger: an unescaped value reaches one of the Scoring render sinks other than the '<' cases the tests cover
summary: Escaping is proven for '<' only: one hostile string <>&"' is needed at every sink (image value, datalist option, summary, preview from/to/subject cells, error.message, fault banner, if_match, revision) with the exact escaped literal asserted. quality-engineer Q2. trigger: a limit is changed or off by one; no test pins 8192/8193 pairs, index 255/256, or exactly 200 rows through dex_form_pairs and dex_form_to_document

trigger: an operator previews a tier change on a fleet with more than 100 applications
summary: The preview does not say what it covers: the model is capped to the 100 applications affecting most devices over 7 days, all platforms, yet 'N of M applications change tier' reads as the whole fleet and apps_total/apps_truncated are never read. happy-path F1, performance P2. trigger: audit_as_session_fn_ unset while the writer is set
